commit.message:
Simplify radix, convolution and finite-selector proof obligations

Use Nat.one_lt_two_pow and Nat.sub_add_cancel for positive radix and
predecessor-exponent bounds in SelectiveCarry and NativeRadixDigits. Factor
word_convolution by distributing sums, explicitly commuting the two sums and
normalizing multiplication. Prove the finite selector's unequal-tag branch
with one successor-inequality equivalence instead of another case split.

Only proof bodies change. All theorem statements, imports, bounds and mask
premises are retained. ArithmeticFiniteSwitch.program still constructs the
same zero and successor PR programs; its generic .val constructor identities
remain rfl. The four modules decrease from 602 to 580 lines, removing 22 lines.

Validation: all four final module/olean builds, four existing focused checks,
SelectiveCoefficientBounds/NativeStencil54/NativeVariableMask/
AnnotatedAxiomDispatch direct clients and generic zero/successor .val audits
pass with the pinned Lean compiler. Baseline and final axiom footprints of
all six checked declarations are the same standard Lean axioms. No new
assumptions, native evaluation shortcuts or API changes are introduced.
commit.diff:
@@ -23,10 +23,7 @@ def program (body : Nat → Nat → Nat) (bodies : ∀ k : Nat,R (body k)) :
     simp only [value]
     by_cases he : n.unpair.1=count
     · simp only [he,Nat.lt_succ_self,if_true]
-    · by_cases hlt : n.unpair.1<count
-      · have hnext : n.unpair.1<count+1 := by omega
-        simp only [he,hlt,hnext,if_false,if_true]
-      · have hnext : ¬n.unpair.1<count+1 := by omega
-        simp only [he,hlt,hnext,if_false]
+    · have hlt : n.unpair.1 < count + 1 ↔ n.unpair.1 < count := by omega
+      simp only [he, if_false, hlt]
 
 end DiophantineConsistency.ArithmeticFiniteSwitch
@@ -76,15 +76,10 @@ theorem word_convolution {ρ : ℕ} (hρ : 1 ≤ ρ) (a c : ZMod n → ℕ) :
       have hp := (pow_mod_length (n := n) hρ (i.val + j.val)).symm
       rw [← ZMod.val_add] at hp
       exact hp.mul_left _
-    _ = ∑ i : ZMod n, (a i * ρ ^ i.val) * word ρ c := by
-      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
-      intro i _
-      rw [word, Finset.mul_sum]
-      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
-      intro j _
-      rw [pow_add]
-      ring
-    _ = word ρ a * word ρ c := by rw [← Finset.sum_mul]; rfl
+    _ = word ρ a * word ρ c := by
+      simp only [word, Finset.sum_mul, Finset.mul_sum, pow_add]
+      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
+      simp only [mul_assoc, mul_left_comm, mul_comm]
 
 theorem finEquiv_val (i : Fin n) : (ZMod.finEquiv n i).val = i.val := by
   cases n with
@@ -51,10 +51,7 @@ theorem decode_originMask {v C : ℕ} (hv : 1 ≤ v) (hC : 0 < C)
     (hmask : (C - 1) &&& word (2 ^ v) (originMask (2 ^ v) bits) = 0) :
     ∃ c : ZMod n → ℕ, word (2 ^ v) c = C ∧ c 0 = 1 ∧
       ∀ k, c k < 2 ^ bits k := by
-  have hr : 1 < 2 ^ v := by
-    have hp := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (n := 2) (by decide) hv
-    norm_num at hp
-    omega
+  have hr : 1 < 2 ^ v := Nat.one_lt_two_pow (by omega)
   have hg : C - 1 < (2 ^ v) ^ n := by omega
   let d := digitArray (n := n) (2 ^ v) (C - 1)
   have hd (k : ZMod n) : d k < 2 ^ v := digitArray_lt hr hg k
@@ -81,9 +78,8 @@ theorem decode_originMask {v C : ℕ} (hv : 1 ≤ v) (hC : 0 < C)
   · intro k
     by_cases hk : k = 0
     · subst k
-      have hp := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (n := 2) (by decide) hfirst
-      norm_num at hp
-      simpa only [c, hd0, ite_true, zero_add] using (show 1 < 2 ^ bits 0 by omega)
+      simpa only [c, hd0, ite_true, zero_add] using
+        (Nat.one_lt_two_pow (by omega : bits 0 ≠ 0))
     · simpa only [c, hk, if_false, add_zero] using hcapacity k
 
 omit [NeZero n] in
@@ -87,18 +87,13 @@ theorem doubled_shifted_polynomial_cast (p : ℤ[X]) {t n : ℕ} (ht : 1 ≤ t)
   simp_rw [add_mul]
   rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, ← eval_eq_sum_range' hd]
   have hpow : (2 : ℤ) ^ t = 2 * 2 ^ (t - 1) := by
-    rw [← pow_succ']
-    congr 1
-    omega
+    rw [← pow_succ', Nat.sub_add_cancel ht]
   rw [hpow]
   ring
 
 theorem shiftedValue_lt {t n : ℕ} (ht : 1 ≤ t) (h : ℕ → ℤ)
     (hb : ∀ i < n, |h i| < 2 ^ (t - 1)) : shiftedValue t n h < (2 ^ t) ^ n := by
-  have hbase : 1 < 2 ^ t := by
-    have hp := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by decide : 1 ≤ 2) ht
-    norm_num at hp
-    omega
+  have hbase : 1 < 2 ^ t := Nat.one_lt_two_pow (by omega)
   rw [shiftedValue]
   have hd : ∀ x ∈ (List.range n).map (fun i => (h i + 2 ^ (t - 1)).toNat), x < 2 ^ t := by
     intro x hx
@@ -109,20 +104,15 @@ theorem shiftedValue_lt {t n : ℕ} (ht : 1 ≤ t) (h : ℕ → ℤ)
       linarith
     rw [Int.toNat_lt hpos]
     have hpow : (2 : ℤ) ^ t = 2 * 2 ^ (t - 1) := by
-      rw [← pow_succ']
-      congr 1
-      omega
+      rw [← pow_succ', Nat.sub_add_cancel ht]
     push_cast
     have := (abs_lt.mp (hb i hi')).2
     linarith
   simpa using Nat.ofDigits_lt_base_pow_length hbase hd
 
 theorem selectedMask_lt {t n : ℕ} (ht : 1 ≤ t) (positions : Finset ℕ) :
     selectedMask t n positions < (2 ^ t) ^ n := by
-  have hbase : 1 < 2 ^ t := by
-    have hp := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by decide : 1 ≤ 2) ht
-    norm_num at hp
-    omega
+  have hbase : 1 < 2 ^ t := Nat.one_lt_two_pow (by omega)
   rw [selectedMask]
   apply (Nat.ofDigits_lt_base_pow_length hbase ?_).trans_le (by simp)
   intro x hx
